beats.label: hook
beats.text: Pearl Abyss spent 6 years building this open world action RPG. 5 million players bought it in the first month.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: You are Kliff — a mercenary in the war-torn continent of Pywel, rebuilding your scattered faction through a directional melee combat system, large-scale siege battles, and co-op exploration across a world that shifts with seasons and weather.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: From the team behind Black Desert Online — cinematic story, a massive open world, and production values that took years to build. The 5 million sales in month one weren't an accident.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Crimson Desert is out now on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Available on Steam.
